Name: Immersive Prismatic Tools
Author: moranor
Description:
[b][size=6]This is a Compatibility Mod[/size][/b]

[size=3]All I'm doing is adding [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15239]Immersive Sprinklers[/url][size=3] and [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15290]Immersive Scarecrows[/url][size=3] functionality and compatibility to [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21450]Prismatic Tools[/url][size=3].[/size]

[size=3]This sadly also means you should disable [/size][i]Immersive Sprinklers[/i][size=3] and [/size][i]Immersive Scarecrows[/i][size=3] in your Mods/ folder, because this mod replaces them. If you choose to download this mod - please make sure to download and endorse them.[/size]

[b][size=5]You don't have to download Prismatic Tools for this mod to function[/size][/b]

[size=3]But then. Why would you even bother with this mod? I'm adding some extra features, but nothing [/size][i]that[/i][size=3] exciting.[/size]

[b][size=5]Features[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][size=3]Sprinklers can be placed in between crops[/size]
[*][size=3]Scarecrows can be placed in between crops[/size]
[*][size=3]Config: Sprinkler radii size[/size]
[*][size=3]Config: Sprinkler radii size for Prismatic Sprinkler [b](new)[/b][/size]
[*][size=3]Config: Crow Protection config for all Sprinklers﻿ [b](new) [/b][i](Important: It will only protect within the sprinkler area though)[/i][/size]
[*][size=3]Config: Sprinkler Textures﻿ config [b](new)[/b][/size]
[*][size=3]Config: Prismatic Bar Texture config﻿ [b](new)[/b][/size]
[*][size=3]Config: Prismatic Tools Texture config﻿ [b](new)[/b][/size]
[/list]
[size=5]Technical[/size]

[size=3]﻿Requires [/size]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url][size=3]﻿﻿﻿.

Implements a[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] [/b]interface to change config settings in-game.[/size]

Manifest.Name: Immersive Prismatic Tools
Manifest.Description: Merges Immersive Sprinklers and Immersive Scarecrows into one mod with native PrismaticTools support. Prismatic sprinklers embedded in soil both water and protect crops.
Manifest.Author: moranor
